sacrifice.deckHelp: Tap a card to add it to the deck; "−" or a tap on a card of the deck above takes one out. Cards in color are yours, a gold frame marks the ones in the deck; under each: on the left the copies in the deck of those allowed, in the middle how many you own, the red "−" on the right takes one out. Grey ones you do not own yet.

sacrifice.rulesText: Each side has four spaces and a scale lies between them. Each turn you get a card from your deck, and a spark if your hand holds none. To play a card, tap it, then a space. Cards cost crystals (units of yours sacrificed from the board) or debris (one for every unit of yours destroyed). Attack ends the turn: your units strike the one across, or the scale if the space is empty. The very first turn of the fight has no attack: the other side has had no chance to put a unit down yet. A lead of {scale} wins. After {maxTurns} turns the side the scale leans to wins.

statHelp.charge: what you can pay in sacrifices right now: the charge of your units on the board, 1 crystal each, 3 with Triple Charge. The number with a crystal in a card’s corner is how many crystals it costs; playing it sacrifices units worth that much (the cheapest, sparks first). Crystals don’t pile up: sacrificed units leave the board.
statHelp.bones: the other way to pay. Every unit of yours destroyed (in battle or as a sacrifice) gives 1 debris; cards with a cog in the corner cost debris instead of sacrifices. Debris piles up all fight.
statHelp.sparks: free units, {n} per fight. A spark comes at the start of your turn if your hand holds none: put it up as a blocker or sacrifice it for 1 crystal.
statHelp.deck: cards left in your deck; you draw one at the start of each turn.
